name: Skeleton
description: A loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of upcoming content
designIntent: Skeleton reduces perceived loading time by showing the layout shape before data arrives. It is aria-hidden so screen readers skip it; pair with a live-region status to announce loading.

props.name: className
props.description: Shape and size classes (e.g. h-4 w-32, rounded-full)

examples.title: Text placeholder
examples.description: Placeholder for a line of text

examples.title: Card placeholder
With live-region announcement
examples.description: Announcing the loading state to screen readers

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Skeleton as a permanent element
antiPatterns.explanation: Skeletons are for loading states only; remove once content renders.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Skeleton without announcing loading
antiPatterns.explanation: Skeleton is aria-hidden. Add a role=status element so screen-reader users know something is loading.

accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a separate status region that announces loading

accessibility.implementation: Pulse animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
accessibility.userRequirements: Don't re-enable animations via CSS overrides

guidelines: Match the shape of the content it replaces
Use consistent skeletons within a view
badExamples: Random sizes that don't match the layout

compositionRules.relationship: Always pair with a status region to announce loading
